feeds.title: Coastal Virginia Magazine
feeds.description: The City & Lifestyle Magazine of Coastal Virginia is a Bi-monthly publication with a focus on Coastal Virginia life, local businesses, events, and community. Stay up to date with the lifestyle, events, restaurants and more from Coastal Virginia.

feeds.title: Outer Banks Coastal Life
feeds.description: Outer Banks Coastal Life (formerly My Outer Banks Home) shares the coastal lifestyle of our beautiful barrier islands. Our publication has brought a variety of fascinating stories to OBX locals and its visitors alike. On everything from local Outer Banks and Eastern North Carolina's events, landmarks, history, and wildlife to community spotlights on the organizations and individuals who make this area so special.

feeds.title: The Coastal Lifestyle Company Blog
feeds.description: For over 17 years we have shared our love affair with the beach by bringing our collection of beautiful finds into the homes of our ever-growing online family and now it is time to give you more! Find out the latest news with products, our ranges, and much more. As well as providing an extensive collection of stylish products influenced by the coast, we would also like to inspire you with gorgeous images, and beach quotes, share with you our recommendations of places to visit, dine or stay by the sea, delicious recipes to try, music to listen to, activities to do, and lots more.

feeds.title: Summer on the Coast Blog
feeds.description: I am Summer. I am a wife, mom of three, and full-time physical therapist who is obsessed with all things home design. What started as me sharing details and updates of my family's home build on my personal Instagram blossomed into Summer On The Coast, a blog where I share all the tips & resources for home design, coastal living, renovations + construction, Real Estate investing, and more. I love to share tips, design ideas, beautiful home inspiration, and the meals I'm cooking each week.

feeds.title: Coastal Crochet
feeds.description: My name is Eleonora and I am passionate about crochet! I started this blog in 2015 as a way to share my passion for crochet with others. And what a creative, crochet-filled, and inspiring journey it's been since then! Read about my crochet patterns, inspirations, designs, and more!

feeds.title: Coastal Lifestyle Magazine
feeds.description: Coastal Lifestyle Magazine is the Premier Gulf Coast Lifestyle publication highlighting the best of upscale coastal living. Explore local dining and entertainment, boating, art, home décor, travel, tour luxury coastal homes, and so much more.

feeds.title: Ocean Home Magazine
feeds.description: Ocean Home is the leading luxury coastal lifestyle magazine. Published bi-monthly, the magazine captures the essence of ocean home living, featuring the best architects, interior designers, landscape architects, and more. The magazine not only unveils dream homes of the top coastal communities but also reveals the best vacation escapes.

feeds.title: Home - Coastal Style Magazine
feeds.description: Coastal Style Magazine is a bi-monthly full color, full gloss publication that celebrates the luxury lifestyle of the Mid-Atlantic region. Our complimentary magazine is distributed strategically to a targeted audience along the Delaware Beaches of Lewes, Rehoboth Beach, Ocean View, Bethany Beach and Fenwick Island.

feeds.title: Our Boat House Blog
feeds.description: Discover coastal furnishings and nautical home decor at Our Boat House. Find nautical furniture, lighting, accessories and other beach house furnishings. Old World rustic lanterns, authentic ship's lamps, vintage wooden oars or ship salvage. We are your source for all coastal finds, rare and unique.

feeds.title: Coastal Living Devon
feeds.description: With interesting articles on the local people, activities, restaurants & more, get your guide to South Devon and the South Hams in our online blog. We are a holiday booking company based in South Devon offering beautiful properties in the South Hams. Let us guide you to select a rental property from our hand-picked portfolio, whilst offering our local knowledge and helping you to select the best choice possible for you and your family.

feeds.title: Cathy Baker Blog
feeds.description: With multiple awards and matched by a stellar reputation across the industry and community, Cathy is a market leader in high-end real estate across the Central Coast. Explore her one-stop-blog for all the great things happening on the Central Coast.

feeds.title: Drift & co Blog
feeds.description: I am Elke. I love the coastal lifestyle and I'm passionate about coastal interiors. Drift is a source of inspiration to share my love of coastal interior design. Drift is my creative outlet to share insights into the coastal way of living, interiors as well as design trends; and showcase local events, artists, places and businesses.

feeds.title: West Michigan Coastal Living
feeds.description: Whether you are looking for the best of the West Michigan Shoreline's real estate, lifestyle, or community happenings, you've come to the right place. Emily is a lover of all things West Michigan, and strives to bring excellence to everything she does in helping clients buy and sell West Michigan properties.

feeds.title: Coastal Ali
feeds.description: I'm Ali. As a former television news producer, I've always loved sharing interesting stories and that's what you'll find here on Coastal Ali. You'll get a little slice of the beach life here, for sure, but also a melange of my other passions, including beautiful homes, photography, art and design, delicious recipes, and my lifelong love of all things French!

feeds.title: Coastal Sotheby's International Realty Blog
feeds.description: We are professional real estate brokers and we're in business for the long term. Our goal is to have high customer satisfaction, leading to referrals and repeat business, and we know that only by putting our clients' interests first, will this come to pass. Read our posts about the Oregon real estate market and local topics that impact you from the expert agents at Coastal Sotheby's International Realty.
